# Data Decision

This area covers the methodological choices made regarding the inclusion or exclusion of specific patient cohorts and surgical codes within the Akut Kirurgi Databasen. These data decisions directly impact the validity, scope, and accuracy of the clinical quality indicators derived from the national registry. The included page details a specific instance where a surgical classification code was retained in the database's population because analysis showed it represented a significant proportion of operations, ensuring comprehensive national quality assessments.

## Pages

- [[data-decision|Data Decision]] — Details the methodological choice to retain the DK65* surgical classification code in the database's population after analysis showed it accounted for 1.7% of operations.
